# Data

```{r}
# data 
sp <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_samples+acquisitions_cleaned.csv"))

obj <- read_csv(file.path(cfg$project$data,"imagery_zooscan_objects_morpho_taxo_cleaned.csv")) %>% 
  left_join(select(sp,sampleid,acquisid,d)) 
```

# Classes and phylum

For this visualization, we only keep classes with more than 50 individuals, and we group Radiolarians with the broader Rhizaria.

```{r}
sel_obj <- obj %>% 
  group_by(scientificname) %>% 
  filter(n() > 50) %>% 
  # assign scientific names Harosa and Rhizaria as phylums
  mutate(phylum=if_else(is.na(phylum),scientificname,phylum)) %>% 
  # group the Radiolarians (Rdiozoa) with Rhizaria
  mutate(phylum=if_else(phylum=="Radiozoa","Rhizaria",phylum))
```

## Boxplot

```{r}
# ---- 1. Weighted quantile  -----------
# compute the quantile # of `x` using `w` as the weight of each observation (here, d)
wtd_quantile <- function(x, w, probs) {
  ord <- order(x)
  x <- x[ord]; w <- w[ord]
  cum_w <- cumsum(w) / sum(w)
  approx(cum_w, x, xout = probs, rule = 2)$y
}

# ---- 2. 5 boxplot stats per group, weighted by d --------
box_stats <- sel_obj %>%
  group_by(class_phylum, phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin   = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.05),  # or 0 for true min
    lower  = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.25),
    middle = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.50),
    upper  = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.75),
    ymax   = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.95),  # or 1 for true max
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ---- 3. Boxplots -------------
pbox <- box_stats %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(class_phylum, middle), fill = phylum)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper, ymax = ymax),
    stat = "identity",
    color = "wheat1"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Annelida" = "#F1A7A3",
                                "Arthropoda" = "#D56B5A",
                                "Bryozoa" = "#FDBF68",
                                "Cercozoa" = "#6C3F60",
                                "Chaetognatha" = "#00A99D",
                                "Chordata" = "#006F6D",
                                "Cnidaria" = "#F28D35",
                                "Echinodermata" = "#6A9A8D",
                                "Foraminifera" = "#9E5D84",
                                "Harosa" = "#A8D1E6",
                                "Mollusca" = "#E3B400",
                                "Rhizaria" = "#D15B1D")) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.25),
        text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  labs(y = "Organism median grey level", x = "", fill = "Phylum")

pbox
```

## Variation

Calculate the weighted moments.

```{r}
# Weighted mean / sd / skewness / kurtosis]
# Weighted central moment of order k: m_k = sum(w*(x-mean_w)^k) / sum(w)
wtd_mean <- function(x, w) sum(w * x) / sum(w)
 
wtd_moment <- function(x, w, k, mu = wtd_mean(x, w)) {
  sum(w * (x - mu)^k) / sum(w)
}
 
wtd_sd <- function(x, w) {
  sqrt(wtd_moment(x, w, 2))
}
 
wtd_skewness <- function(x, w) {
  mu <- wtd_mean(x, w)
  m2 <- wtd_moment(x, w, 2, mu)
  m3 <- wtd_moment(x, w, 3, mu)
  m3 / m2^1.5
}
 
wtd_kurtosis <- function(x, w, excess = FALSE) {
  mu <- wtd_mean(x, w)
  m2 <- wtd_moment(x, w, 2, mu)
  m4 <- wtd_moment(x, w, 4, mu)
  k <- m4 / m2^2
  if (excess) k - 3 else k   # moments::kurtosis() is NOT excess (normal = 3)
}


# order by classes transparency
order_levels <- arrange(box_stats, middle)

# calculate skewness, kurtosis and standard deviation 
allspread <- sel_obj %>%
  mutate(class_phylum = factor(class_phylum, levels = unique(order_levels$class_phylum))) %>%
  group_by(class_phylum, phylum) %>%
  summarize(
    sk   = wtd_skewness(grey_median, d),
    kurt = wtd_kurtosis(grey_median, d),
    std  = wtd_sd(grey_median, d),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Plot them toghether.

```{r}
psk <- allspread %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=class_phylum,y="Skewness",size=sk)) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  geom_point(color="grey80") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(text=element_text(size=12),
        #axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        #axis.ticks.x=element_blank(),
        #axis.line.x=element_blank(),
        legend.position="none") + 
  labs(x="",y="")

pkurt <- allspread %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=class_phylum,y="Kurtosis",size=kurt)) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  geom_point(color="grey80") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.line.y=element_blank()) + 
  labs(x="",y="")

pstd <- allspread %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=class_phylum,y="Standard \ndeviation",size=std)) + 
  coord_flip() + 
  geom_point(color="grey80") + 
  theme_classic() + 
  theme(legend.position="none",
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),
        axis.line.y=element_blank()) + 
  labs(x="",y="")
```

Together:

```{r}
# variation
pdot <- psk + pkurt + pstd + plot_layout(ncol=3) 

# together
pall <- (pdot | pbox) +  
  plot_layout(widths=c(1,2.5))  +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "","","b"))) &  # manual tag list
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = "topleft")
pall
```

# Details of scientificnames

## Boxplot

Same as before, but separated into scientificnames.

```{r}
box_stats_name <- sel_obj %>%
  group_by(scientificname, class_phylum, phylum) %>%
  summarise(
    ymin   = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.05),
    lower  = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.25),
    middle = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.50),
    upper  = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.75),
    ymax   = wtd_quantile(grey_median, d, 0.95),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(select(box_stats, class_phylum, middle_class = middle), by = "class_phylum") %>%
  arrange(middle_class, middle) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())            # <- continuous axis position, 1 per species
 
# Where to put each class_phylum label: center of its block of species,
# and where the blocks change (for optional divider lines)
class_labels <- box_stats_name %>%
  group_by(class_phylum) %>%
  summarise(y_pos = mean(row_id), .groups = "drop")
 
class_boundaries <- box_stats_name %>%
  group_by(class_phylum) %>%
  summarise(max_row = max(row_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice(-n()) %>%                          # drop the last one, no line needed after final group
  pull(max_row)
 
pbox_species <- ggplot(box_stats_name, aes(x = row_id, fill = phylum,group=row_id, color=phylum)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(ymin = ymin, lower = lower, middle = middle, upper = upper, ymax = ymax),
    stat = "identity",
    width = 0.5
  ) +
  # divider lines between phylum blocks (drawn as vline pre-flip -> horizontal after coord_flip)
  #geom_vline(xintercept = class_boundaries + 0.5, color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = class_labels$y_pos,
    labels = class_labels$class_phylum,
    expand = expansion(add = 1)
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Annelida" = "#F1A7A3",
                                "Arthropoda" = "#D56B5A",
                                "Bryozoa" = "#FDBF68",
                                "Cercozoa" = "#6C3F60",
                                "Chaetognatha" = "#00A99D",
                                "Chordata" = "#006F6D",
                                "Cnidaria" = "#F28D35",
                                "Echinodermata" = "#6A9A8D",
                                "Foraminifera" = "#9E5D84",
                                "Harosa" = "#A8D1E6",
                                "Mollusca" = "#E3B400",
                                "Rhizaria" = "#D15B1D")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Annelida" = "#F1A7A3",
                                "Arthropoda" = "#D56B5A",
                                "Bryozoa" = "#FDBF68",
                                "Cercozoa" = "#6C3F60",

                                "Harosa" = "#A8D1E6",
                                "Mollusca" = "#E3B400",
                                "Rhizaria" = "#D15B1D")) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(vjust = 0.25),
```
